user_query: I'm planning a road trip with my friends and we want to visit some famous landmarks along the way. Can you provide me with information about the top attractions in each city we'll be passing through? Also, I'd like to see videos on Likee that showcase the beauty of these landmarks. Lastly, can you find any related profiles on Instagram that share travel experiences in these cities?

TaskList.description: Gather a list of cities that will be visited during the road trip.
Research and compile information about the top attractions in each city along the route.
Search for videos on Likee that showcase the beauty of the landmarks in each city.
Find Instagram profiles that share travel experiences relevant to the cities in the itinerary.
